Definition: neuter of a presumed compound of G5259 and G3025; vessel or receptacle under the press, i.e. lower wine-vat:--winefat.
BiblicalUsage: hypolḗnion means a wine-vat, the lower vat. In Mark 12:1, the text says "and digged [a place for] the winefat."
TheologicalSignificance: In hypolḗnion I find no hidden theology; it simply means a wine-vat, the lower vat.
RelatedEvents: The Parable of the Wicked Tenants
